latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — quickly convert your images into shareable animated videos using simple text prompts.

- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images (up to 200MB) and describe your desired video; the skill handles formatting, transitions, and rendering.
- No video editing experience required — just type what you want and get a 1080p MP4 or other video formats in under a minute.
- Automatic session setup, cloud rendering, and credit tracking — minimal setup required.
- Supports export, status checks, credit balance, and timeline previews via natural language commands.
- Handles common backend errors with clear, helpful guidance for next steps.
